A.label: signature vs electronic upload
A.reason: signature rows quote signature/seal clauses; CA upload text stays in ELECTRONIC_UPLOAD

B.label: submission contamination
B.reason: submission rows carry only deadline/platform/copies content; fee and evaluation-report text is not owned

C.label: file composition evidence
C.reason: composition rows are built from composition/format clauses, never from objection-letter text

D.label: file format evidence
D.old_concern: FILE_FORMAT (from 备选方案/联系方式)
D.reason: format rows quote real format clauses; unsupported format claims are filtered

E.label: technical plan evidence
E.reason: technical-plan rows require plan/进度/应急/质量 source atoms

F.label: financial commitment ownership
F.old_concern: QUALIFICATION_FINANCIAL (from 资金来源：企业自筹)
F.reason: project financing is not a supplier financial-capability duty

G.label: installation quantities
G.old_concern: TECHNICAL/安装调试与验收 (any nearby quantity)

H.label: bid-bond material isolation
H.reason: bond materials come only from bond atoms (transfer receipt, basic-account documents)

I.label: contract/payment contamination
I.reason: qualification restrictions are owned by QUALIFICATION_RELATIONSHIP_RESTRICTION

J.label: internal procedure filtering
J.old_concern: bidder rows from 评审小组回避/纪律/术语定义
J.new_concern: filtered, or an explicit non-bidder 备查 row
J.reason: internal procedure / definition atoms are filtered or labelled 仅备查，无需投标响应

K.label: false price-limit concern
K.old_concern: PRICING/分项限价与暂列金额 (from a heading)
K.reason: a 分项报价表 heading alone never creates a limit/provisional-sum row

L.label: scoring ownership
L.reason: every score figure traces to the concern's own scoring atoms (untraceable: none)

M.label: mixed evaluation split
M.old_concern: EVALUATION (串标 + 银行承兑 combined)
M.reason: collusion analysis and acceptance-ratio scoring are separate concerns

N.label: technical vs eligibility/rejection
N.reason: same-manufacturer/same-brand restrictions are eligibility/competition rules, not technical parameters
